content.text:
The `.disabled` compound selector in the CSS module is `.footer-link.disabled { pointer-events: none; cursor: default; }`. CSS Modules treats `.disabled` as a standalone class — the compound selector `.footer-link.disabled` means both classes must be present on the element. The JSX applies both `styles['footer-link']` and `styles['disabled']`, so the compound selector will fire. That's correct.
